title: Betterment Taken for Parts Replaced on an Older or Harder-Worked Vehicle
content:
Where new parts leave a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan better than it was before the loss, a betterment share is taken off the cost. The marketplace's betterment mileage mark is 60000 miles and its betterment model-year mark is 2018.

- Where the odometer standing on the listing is above the marketplace's betterment mileage mark and the model year of the vehicle is at or before the marketplace's betterment model-year mark, the higher betterment share of 15 percent is taken off the cost.
- Where the odometer is above that mark and the model year is after that mark, the lower betterment share of 8 percent is taken off.
- Where the odometer is at or below that mark, nothing is taken off for betterment.

### Both sides of both marks

| Odometer | Model year | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| above 60000 | 2018 or earlier | 15 percent |
| above 60000 | 2019 or later | 8 percent |
| 60000 or below | either | nothing |

An odometer reading of exactly 60000 is at the mark and not above it, so nothing is taken off however old the vehicle; a reading of 60001 is above it. A model year of exactly 2018 is at the mark, and the higher share governs.

### The records behind the reading

The odometer reading and the model year are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing standing for that vehicle.
